From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs, retention — next steps

Hi Jamie / Rajesh,

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have alignment on scope and priorities from Acme's perspective. I captured the pain points, goals, and the immediate info you asked for.

Key pain points discussed:
- Need: centralized inference runtime with strict audit logging for model inputs/outputs for compliance reviews.
- Concern: data retention policies and ability to configure retention windows per environment (prod vs staging).
- Risk: customer data encryption at rest and customer-managed key (CMK) support for regulated workloads.
- Evidence: you requested SOC 2 Type II report and pen test summary for vendor security review.

Goals we aligned on:
1) Provide SOC 2 Type II report and a checklist of evidence items you can hand to internal auditors.
2) Confirm retention defaults and show how to configure retention/archival for logs and KV cache.
3) Share DPA template and a redline path for legal/procurement.
4) Confirm KMS/HSM options for customer-managed keys and key rotation.

Attachments included (initial drop):
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_Report_2025.pdf (SOC 2 report — redacted)
- SOC2-SSAE18-evidence-checklist.xlsx (mapping of artifacts we can provide)

Immediate next steps:
- Marissa: Share pen test summary and DPA template (by EOD today). (OWNER: marissa_cole)
- Rishi: Coordinate internal commercial terms and provide preliminary pricing for Dedicated capacity (by next Tue). (OWNER: rishi_malhotra)
- Acme: Confirm any additional evidence or legal clauses you need us to surface for procurement (Rajesh/Jamie). (OWNER: Acme)

If the above matches your expectation, I'll open a HubSpot record and upload the documents to the shared drive link below for your security team. Happy to set a short follow-up with our security/infra lead if your SecOps team wants a walkthrough.

Shared evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-redwood/acme-evidence

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs, retention — next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our side after the call:

- Pen test evidence: can you confirm whether you can provide an internal summary (high level) or the full report under an NDA? Our InfoSec prefers at least a pen test exec summary + remediation timeline.
- Retention: what's your default retention for request logs and model output? We expect to keep audit logs for a minimum of 1 year for compliance. Will Redwood support that out of the box or do we need Dedicated/Private?
- Keys: can you confirm support for customer-managed keys (we use AWS KMS) and whether key usage is logged separately?
- DPA: please send your DPA template — we'll circulate to legal. If there are non-negotiable clauses, flag them so our counsel can triage.

Open items — we will confirm availability next week for a technical walkthrough with our SecOps.

Thanks,
Jamie Liu
Security Program Manager, Acme Corp
jamie.liu@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit logs, retention — next steps

Jamie — thanks for the quick follow-up. Answers inline below and I've attached the additional artifacts you asked for.

Pen test evidence:
- Attached: PenTest_Summary_2024.pdf — this is an executive summary we provide publicly. For full reports we require an NDA; we can route a redacted version to Acme under NDA.

Retention:
- Default request/audit logs retention is 90 days for hosted tenants; we offer configurable retention for Dedicated and Private deployments. We can support 1-year retention for audit logs via our Dedicated plan or by exporting logs to your S3 for long-term archival (we recommend an S3 lifecycle policy).

Customer-managed keys (KMS):
- We support AWS KMS CMKs for Dedicated and Private customers. Key usage is logged to CloudTrail; we can provide a mapping of where keys are used and audit events.

DPA:
- Attached: DPA_Template_Redwood_v1.docx. Highlights: Standard data processing terms, breach notification timelines, subprocessors list (we include cloud infra partners). If you want us to accept a counter-redline, Rishi will coordinate commercial/legal.

Attachments included:
- PenTest_Summary_2024.pdf (application/pdf)
- DPA_Template_Redwood_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Schedule a SecOps walkthrough: propose Wed 7/8 or Thu 7/9 — please share availability. (OWNER: Acme SecOps + Marissa)
- We will provision a shared S3 export demo to show retention/export flow for logs. (OWNER: marissa_cole / infra)
- Rishi will follow up on commercial terms and DPA redline process. (OWNER: rishi_malhotra)

Let me know if you'd like any additional artifacts in the meantime.

Best,

Marissa Cole
